methodologyNotes: Self-serve USD pricing was collected from each vendor's official pricing page or the closest reachable official page on 2026-06-14. eFax's pricing page geo-redirects to a German EUR page and also renders prices via JavaScript (placeholder '$  /mo'); plan tier names, page limits, and overage rates were obtained from efax.com/corporate. The entry-tier (Personal) self-serve price of $18.99/mo is independently corroborated by GetApp, G2, and multiple 2026 pricing reviews (all agreeing on $18.99/mo, 200 pages, $0.10/page overage) and is therefore recorded as 18.99 rather than null. The second tier (Business) price could not be confirmed — secondary sources disagree on both naming and price for the mid tier (variously $24.99, $31.99, $49.99 under names Pro/Protect with differing page counts that do not match the official 500-page/5-user Business tier) — so its monthlyUsd remains null. Corporate is quote-only (null). Dropbox Fax (formerly HelloFax) subscription plan prices are also JavaScript-rendered and not returned in page HTML; the pay-as-you-go rate was directly readable. RingCentral does not sell a standalone online-fax product — fax is bundled into RingEX unified-communications plans whose prices are also JavaScript-rendered; the plan is recorded as custom/null. SRFax pricing is from their official healthcare solutions page which rendered fully. FaxZero, MyFax, and iFax prices are from their respective official pricing pages. annualDiscountPct is recorded only when both monthly and annual rates are explicitly published. minutesIncluded, callsIncluded, overagePerMin, and overagePerCall are null on every plan (non-telephony product).

vendors.name: eFax
vendors.provenance: https://www.efax.com/corporate (official page, accessed 2026-06-14; prices are JavaScript-rendered placeholders '$  /mo' — USD amounts not resolvable). Fallback for starting price: https://www.getapp.com/content-management-software/a/efax/ (aggregator, accessed 2026-06-14, states starting from $18.99/month).

plans.name: Personal
plans.notes: 200 pages/month to US & Canada. 1 user license, 1 fax number. HIPAA compliant. Overage $0.10/page. One-time $10 setup fee; promotional first month ~$4.99. The official page renders prices as '$ /mo' placeholders (JavaScript-rendered, geo-redirects to EUR), so the $18.99/mo self-serve entry price is corroborated independently by GetApp, G2, and multiple 2026 pricing reviews (faxdrop, mFax, ifaxapp efax-pricing guide), all of which agree eFax's entry tier starts at $18.99/mo with 200 pages and $0.10/page overage.

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: 500 pages/month to 51 countries. 5 user licenses. HIPAA compliant + BAA. Overage $0.07/page. Exact monthly USD price not resolvable from official page (JavaScript-rendered).

plans.name: Corporate
plans.notes: Fully customizable plan; contact sales for quote. HIPAA + BAA + HITRUST certified. Includes dedicated account management, full API access, admin portal, toll-free numbers.

vendors.name: Dropbox Fax (formerly HelloFax)
vendors.provenance: https://app.hellofax.com/info/pricing (official pricing page via redirect chain hellofax.com → fax.dropbox.com → app.hellofax.com, accessed 2026-06-14; subscription plan prices are JavaScript-rendered and not returned in page HTML). Pay-as-you-go rate and free-tier details were directly readable from https://fax.dropbox.com (accessed 2026-06-14).

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: 5 free fax pages included. Sending only (receiving requires paid plan). Additional faxes at $0.99/fax (up to 10 pages), then $0.20/page. No credit card required.

plans.name: Paid Subscription Plans
plans.notes: Paid subscription plans exist that include fax receiving, dedicated fax number (US/UK/Canada), and $0.05/page overage. Exact monthly USD prices are JavaScript-rendered on the pricing page and could not be retrieved. No setup or cancellation fees; monthly or annual billing available.

vendors.name: RingCentral Fax
vendors.provenance: https://www.ringcentral.com/fax.html and https://www.ringcentral.com/office/plansandpricing.html (official pages, accessed 2026-06-14). Fax is bundled into RingEX unified-communications plans; no standalone fax-only pricing page exists. Plan prices are JavaScript-rendered and not returned in page HTML. HIPAA compliance confirmed via https://www.ringcentral.com/legal/privacy-notice/hipaa.html.

plans.name: RingEX (fax included)
plans.notes: Online fax (up to 20 MB attachments, up to 50 recipients per send) is included in all RingEX tiers (Core, Advanced, Ultra). Per-user monthly prices are JavaScript-rendered and could not be retrieved from the official page. Annual billing saves up to 33%. HIPAA/HITRUST/GDPR/PCI certified. Contact sales for fax-volume add-ons.
